Name: Nutramax Denosyl Tablets for Cats & Small Dogs, 30 tablets
Natural: Nutramax Denosyl Tablets for Cats & Small Dogs, 30 tablets; Denosyl has been shown to markedly increase liver levels of glutathione, an important compound for liver health formed when SAMe (S-Adenosylmethionine) is metabolized. It has also been shown to help protect liver cells from cell death, and may help cell repair and regeneration. While best known for supporting the liver, Denosyl also has a place in supporting brain health. It can help your best friend live a longer, healthier life
